messages:
carmen: opened a small docs PR to add a Python SDK example and an explainer about configuring base_url for Vercel previews. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2401  planning to merge in tomorrow's docs slot if CI and preview are good.

vercel-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood-docs-pr-2401.vercel.app — initial load looks fine but CSS seems stale on hard refresh for some users (maybe CDN cache).

ryan: saw that too. locally `mkdocs serve` shows the new CSS but the vercel preview served older bundle (styles.css v1.2.0 vs expected v1.2.3). could be Vercel Edge caching or service worker from older preview.

tess: quick repro: open preview in incognito or append `?noredirect=1` — i saw the updated styles. not ideal for reviewers.

carmen: hmm branch name is `docs/py-sdk-helpers` (has slash). Vercel treats that OK but our cache keys include the branch name with slashes normalized — weird. I added a query param cache-buster in the preview link for reviewers.

docs-ci: CI kicked for PR #2401 — checks: lint, mkdocs-build, linkcheck, screenshot-tests. screenshot-tests: 1 failure (old stylesheet snapshot mismatch).

devex: for the Python snippet remember to show a minimal `requirements.txt` and mention `requests` version. also include a tiny code example for both sync (requests) and async (httpx) users — helps reduce review comments.

carmen: added requirements and both examples. snippet: ```python
# requirements.txt
redwood-sdk==1.1.0
requests==2.31.0
httpx==0.24.0
```
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate_text("hello from python")
print(resp.text)
```
async example: ```python
import asyncio
from redwood.async_client import AsyncClient
async def main():
    client = AsyncClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
    resp = await client.generate_text("hi")
    print(resp.text)
asyncio.run(main())
```

ryan: thanks. i left a tiny nit: add a one-line about `pip install -r requirements.txt` and optional virtualenv.

carmen: added that note. pushed.

vercel-bot: New preview: https://redwood-docs-pr-2401.vercel.app/?_v=2 — stylesheet updated 197");
